currency.description: One currency for all subject amounts, e.g. CNY. No automatic currency conversion.

amount_scale.description: Positive multiplier for all aggregate amounts and scenario unit prices. '1'=base currency, '10000'=ten-thousands, '1000000'=millions. Value per share is ALWAYS base currency / one share.

input_basis.description: Optional per-input basis map using dot JSON paths, e.g. base.revenue, forecast.0.ebit_margin, dcf.discount.wacc. Disclosed means stated by an identified source; derived means computed from cited inputs; assumption means an explicitly proposed research choice. Each entry requires a rationale. Put citations only in source_refs at the SAME path; do not duplicate references here. Missing metadata means unclassified, never implicitly disclosed. After manually changing a sourced value, mark the new draft value as assumption unless independently re-established from a cited source.

source_refs.description: Map input JSON paths to arrays of {kind:'source'|'document'|'artifact',id,locator,quote?,revision_id?}. exposed_material_share.description: Explicit share (0..1) of baseline raw-material cost exposed to this shock; never inferred from company name.

lag_years.description: Whole annual periods; pre-horizon material cost changes are explicitly assumed zero.

price_elasticity.description: Explicit nonpositive coefficient for linear demand change relative to baseline; 0 means no demand effect.

autonomous_price_changes.description: One value per baseline year. Level relative to that year's baseline, not cumulative increment. Must exceed -1.

cash_tax_policy.description: floor_at_zero taxes only positive EBIT. immediate_credit allows same-year loss credits. Neither models NOL carryforwards.

wacc.description: Positive annual WACC, consistent currency/inflation with FCFF; terminal growth must be lower.

cashflow_timing.description: mid_year discounts explicit year t at t-0.5; terminal value is always measured/discounted at year n end.

growth.description: Stable annual growth: 0 <= g < WACC and g <= ROIC. Negative-growth/liquidation models are outside this model.

roic.description: Explicit positive stable after-tax return on invested capital. Reinvestment fraction = g/ROIC.

ebit_margin.description: Explicit normalized stable EBIT/revenue, after D&A, greater than zero and <=1.

tax_rate.description: Finite decimal; use a decimal string to preserve digits. Ratios use fractions: 0.10 means 10%, not 10.

S = lambda x: format(x, 'f')

# ---- 已披露 2025H1（合并，元），来自 document f0703e7591bd4f0b8040ffa44e656f42 ----
rev_h1 = d('18181039589.02')      # p.81 营业总收入
cogs_h1 = d('14122571351.06')     # p.81 营业成本
op_profit_h1 = d('1372866154.73') # p.81 营业利润
dep_h1 = d('324169416.26'); rou_h1 = d('20449840.18')
amort_i_h1 = d('33575313.69'); amort_lt_h1 = d('2210361.15')   # p.164
capex_h1 = d('186255639.63')      # p.86 购建固定资产等支付现金
cash_eq_end = d('8267960825.87')  # p.164 现金及现金等价物期末

# ---- 2025-06-30 营运资本（合并）p.75/76，定义：应收类+存货+预付+合同资产-应付类 ----
ar = d('12876792917.79'); notes_r = d('180156805.69'); fin_r = d('358166330.58')
prepaid = d('373096953.94'); other_r = d('1056782783.56')
inv = d('8517310372.76'); contract_a = d('185604352.52')
ap = d('7620788262.01'); notes_p = d('6420491177.46')
contract_l = d('589177904.10'); advance = d('42572797.60')
wc_assets = ar+notes_r+fin_r+prepaid+other_r+inv+contract_a
wc_liab = ap+notes_p+contract_l+advance
nwc_h1 = wc_assets - wc_liab

# ---- 有息负债（2025-06-30 合并）p.76/77 ----
st_loan = d('7575873070.78'); cur_lt = d('543144087.70')
other_cur_bond = d('33156669.51')   # t177 其他流动负债中的短期应付债券
lt_loan = d('390074162.19'); bonds = d('2567789790.26')  # 应付债券（含柳工转2债务成分）
lease = d('147139960.38')
debt = st_loan+cur_lt+other_cur_bond+lt_loan+bonds+lease

nci = d('1453349255.75')            # 少数股东权益 p.77
other_eq_instr = d('84407721.27')   # 其他权益工具（无优先股/永续债）p.77
shares = d('2019243764')            # 股本（面值1元）p.77

# ---- 2025 全年基期：H1 x 2 年化（研究假设） ----
scale = D(2)
rev_fy = rev_h1*scale
cogs_fy = cogs_h1*scale
op_profit_fy = op_profit_h1*scale
da_fy = (dep_h1+rou_h1+amort_i_h1+amort_lt_h1)*scale
da_in_cogs = da_fy*d('0.6')          # 假设60%折旧计入营业成本
cash_cogs_fy = cogs_fy - da_in_cogs
fixed_bucket_fy = rev_fy - cash_cogs_fy - da_fy - op_profit_fy

asp = d('250000')                    # 假设整体等效均价（元/台）
volume_fy = rev_fy/asp
mat_share = d('0.65'); oth_share = d('0.35')
mat_unit = cash_cogs_fy*mat_share/volume_fy
oth_unit = cash_cogs_fy*oth_share/volume_fy
nwc_ratio = nwc_h1/rev_fy

# ---- 基线预测 2026-2030 ----
years = [2026,2027,2028,2029,2030]
growth = [d('0.08'),d('0.07'),d('0.06'),d('0.055'),d('0.05')]
capex_ratio = d('0.0105')
da_ratio = da_fy/rev_fy
fixed_g = d('0.04')
tax = d('0.17')
rows=[]; prev=rev_fy; fc=[]; fa=[]
for y,g in zip(years,growth):
    r = prev*(D(1)+g); prev=r
    v = r/asp
    fx = fixed_bucket_fy*(D(1)+fixed_g)**D(years.index(y)+1)
    rows.append(dict(year=y, revenue=S(r), volume=S(v), unit_price=S(asp),
        material_cost_per_unit=S(mat_unit), other_variable_cost_per_unit=S(oth_unit),
        fixed_cash_opex=S(fx), da=S(r*da_ratio), capex=S(r*capex_ratio),
        nwc_ratio=S(nwc_ratio), tax_rate=S(tax)))
    fc.append(r*da_ratio)
ebit_fy = rev_fy - cash_cogs_fy - fixed_bucket_fy - da_fy
out = dict(
  disclosed_h1=dict(revenue=S(rev_h1),cogs=S(cogs_h1),op_profit=S(op_profit_h1)),
  fy2025e=dict(revenue=S(rev_fy), cogs=S(cogs_fy), da=S(da_fy), da_in_cogs=S(da_in_cogs),
     cash_cogs=S(cash_cogs_fy), op_profit_target=S(op_profit_fy), fixed_bucket=S(fixed_bucket_fy),
     ebit_check=S(ebit_fy), volume=S(volume_fy), mat_unit=S(mat_unit), other_unit=S(oth_unit),
     nwc_end_2025e=S(nwc_h1), nwc_ratio=S(nwc_ratio), da_ratio=S(da_ratio)),
  base_balances=dict(wc_assets=S(wc_assets), wc_liab=S(wc_liab), nwc=S(nwc_h1)),
  bridge=dict(debt=S(debt), cash=S(cash_eq_end), net_debt=S(debt-cash_eq_end),
     nci=S(nci), other_equity_instruments=S(other_eq_instr), shares=S(shares)),
  forecast=rows)
print(json.dumps(out, ensure_ascii=False, indent=1))
open('/output/scenario_inputs.json','w').write(json.dumps(out, ensure_ascii=False, indent=1))
